description: What Indonesian dealers pay today to buy back ONE gold bar of a given brand and weight, in rupiah: the highest price that fits every bar of that brand and size, prices that fit only some bars (for example Antam made in 2026), each with dealer and day, and a world-gold-price estimate when no dealer FiLot reads prices the brand. Brands with dealer prices: Antam (Logam Mulia), UBS, Lotus Archi, Galeri 24, Sampoerna; any other brand (King Halim, PAMP, Argor-Heraeus, ...) gets the estimate and Galeri 24's Sentra Buyback line.

brand.description: Brand stamped on the bar, e.g. Antam, UBS, Lotus Archi, Galeri 24, Sampoerna, King Halim, PAMP.

grams.description: Weight of ONE bar in grams (1 troy ounce = 31.1 g; 1 kg = 1000).

lang.description: Answer language: id = Bahasa Indonesia, en = English (default).

name: gold_buyback_prices
title: Indonesian gold buyback prices for one bar
